remarks: Beautiful and private 3 BR/3.5 bath almost new townhouse with attached 2 car garage in Ainslie Square community which offers clubhouse, gym and pool. Open floor plan, quartz countertops in kitchen. Each bedroom has its own bathroom. The master suite with full bath, walk-in closet, and seating area is privately located on the third floor, natural gas heating. Convenient location, 5 minutes from downtown Stamford and within walking distance of the Glenbrook train station.
